Mission Local reported that SF State lecturers were told their classes would be cut back, sometimes entirely, starting in spring. The cuts affected an unknown number of the university’s 1,084 lecturers; the union said lecturers would be affected several times more than the equivalent 125 full-time positions because most work part-time. Some lecturers would lose a class or two, while others would lose their entire workloads. Lecturers faced the largest cuts, about a 30 percent decrease for most colleges, according to a university budget presentation.

Story: “San Francisco State University facing mass staffing cuts,” published September 29, 2023.
